articles.summary: Drive-thrus have a history of innovation. The first two-way speaker was invented by the founder of In-N-Out Burger. That trend continues to this day. Fast food companies are experimenting with new technology at their fast food windows, like AI chatbots or elevator food delivery systems that cut out human-to-human interaction.
